narrative.overview:
Nuova sells corporate store roll-outs to large retail chains. The visual system is split into one durable brand layer and three candidate worlds. The brand layer holds what does not change whichever world wins: the binding yellow and near-black pair, the logo files, the Spanish (Perú) voice, the shared lead form and its WhatsApp hand-off, the proof and truth rules, and the WhatsApp floating button. Each world reads the same content through one physical metaphor taken from Nuova's own trade: the shipment leaving the Ate plant (A), the gondola shelf with its yellow cenefa and hanging hablador (B), and the store floor plan (C).

Every world is static HTML/CSS/JS with one inline `<style>` block, self-hosted fonts (`assets/fonts/fonts.css`) and the shared `assets/js/lead.js`. Every world honours `prefers-reduced-motion` by cancelling all animation and transition, and shares the house ease `cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)`.
keyCharacteristics: One binding colour pair, #FFD207 + #1E1E1C, used at full strength in every world; yellow is a material (tape, shelf edge, built fixture), never a decorative tint.
Heavy, tight display type (900 weight, line-height 0.8 to 0.98) over a plain, readable body face.
Square-cut forms: radii of 0 to 3px everywhere except the round WhatsApp button and status dot.
Numbers presented as manifest or sheet lines with tabular figures.
Only verifiable nuova.pe facts as proof; anything else is marked as a placeholder.

rules.name: The Binding Pair Rule
rules.body: #FFD207 and #1E1E1C appear in every world, unmodified. Text on yellow is always ink. No world swaps either colour for a nearby hue; B's darker yellow lip (b-yellow-lip) only shades the edge of a yellow object and is never a flat fill on its own.

rules.name: The Tape Owns The Seams Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears as full-width packing tape across section seams (top of page, after the hero, before the close) and as the strap holding each label. It is a material, not a scattered accent.

rules.name: The Stencil Is Cargo Rule
rules.body: Stencil type is for things painted on the box: headlines, numbers, destination codes, list items. Running text and form input stay in Archivo.

rules.name: The Paper-On-Board Rule
rules.body: Loose paper (labels, prints) may rotate up to ±0.8deg; rotation is removed at ≤1080px. Shadows stay warm brown (rgba(60,35,10,…)).

rules.name: The Cenefa Is The Shelf Rule
rules.body: Yellow bands with a darker lip mark where content rests: the top of the hero bay, the form bar, under section heads (12px), the process rail (22px), the gallery base (16px). Yellow is a shelf or a tag, not a highlight.

rules.name: The Price Tag Rule
rules.body: Claims are numerals or short words in heavy condensed type sitting on a tag, with a 2px rule separating them from the explanation.

rules.name: The Whole Slot Rule
rules.body: The perforated-upright pattern repeats in whole 25px units (`background-repeat: round`); a slot is never cut in half.

rules.name: The Yellow Is Installed Rule
rules.body: On the plan, yellow means built. Unbuilt fixtures are dashed Linework High; yellow fill arrives with the installation phase. Off the plan, yellow marks only the one primary action, the active state and a single emphasis word.

rules.name: The Mono For Measures Rule
rules.body: Chivo Mono is used only for codes, dimensions, sheet numbers and figures. It never sets prose or headings.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: The 32px drafting grid (`rgba(242,239,230,.045)` hairlines) appears only inside drawing sheets and the photo frame, never on the open page ground.

dos: Do write in Spanish (Perú), professional and close, speaking to chains and roll-outs rather than single shops.
Do limit proof to nuova.pe facts: "+50 empresas", "cientos de negocios", 24 departamentos, Google reviews 5★, and the product counts from the nuova.pe catalogue.

Do caption imagery as what it is: 3D renders as "Diseño 3D · …", the floor plan as "Plano ilustrativo · medidas referenciales", missing project photos as a visibly marked placeholder ("Foto de proyecto pendiente").
Do route every lead form through `form[data-lead]` and `assets/js/lead.js`, keeping WhatsApp +51 903 260 296 visible next to the form and as the fixed FAB.
Do draw every icon, pictogram and glyph as inline SVG.
Do number figures and steps like manifest lines (01, 02, N° 003) in tabular stencil figures.
Do keep forms and data panels as ruled shipping labels on Label Stock.
Do put claims on habladores and content on cenefa-edged shelves.
Do frame photo and product bays with perforated uprights in whole slot units.
Do number every drawing as a sheet ("Lámina A-01") and keep dimensions in Chivo Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep linework warm grey and reserve yellow fill for what Nuova builds.
donts: Don't show Sodimac, Promart, Plaza Vea, Tottus or Oechsle as clients; they are prospects.
Don't invent years in business, plant size, capacity, certifications, named testimonials, delivery times or product dimensions.
Don't mix tokens or signature devices from two proposals on one surface.
Don't break the tape mid-phrase; it repeats only in whole units.
Don't use cool grey shadows or radii above 2px.
Don't use yellow as text colour on steel or as a thin accent line; it is a band or a tag.
Don't let a hablador hang without its clip.
Don't spread the drafting grid onto the page ground outside sheets.
Don't present plan measurements as real specifications; the plan stays "ilustrativo · medidas referenciales".
